lore: A short book that knows the portals and the pocket worlds behind them.
use: The Simple Dimensions Guide explains the portals and the pocket worlds behind them. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.

lore: A portal block through which you can feel the wind of another sky.
use: The blocks of a Skyblock portal: build a glowstone arch and light it with fire next to an emitting block. It carries only players, never mobs or items, and checks a safe return.
secret: Glowstone, fire, soul fire and portal blocks do not count as the emitter. Claims you cannot enter also block the trip.

lore: A portal that remembers an older version of the world.
use: A legacy block, block entity and item ID kept so old worlds still load. It has no recipe, no loot source and no creative tab entry.
secret: You will only ever meet it in an old world. Nothing new is built from it.
